name: smwgraphics-fraktur-font
title: Fraktur Font
description:
One of the Blackletter styles now in 8x8 for use in SMW hacks - Fraktur. Useful for hacks who would like to replicate a medieval and gothic horror theme in your hacks.

See important.txt for more information.

Uses SMW's Default palette, more specifically the color slot used in SMW's message boxes. All graphics if used, must replace GFX2A once extracted in the Graphics folder.

V1.1 Update - Most uppercase letters and lowercase letters that were particularly hard to read such as k were updated in response to criticism.
